name: firefox-apollo-theme
description: A high-contrast Firefox theme generated from the canonical Apollo palette.

scripts.dev:dark: web-ext run --source-dir . --firefox deved --start-url about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md CLAUDE.md LICENSE palette scripts tests variants .github
scripts.lint: npm run lint:dark && npm run lint:light
scripts.lint:dark: web-ext lint --source-dir . --warnings-as-errors --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md CLAUDE.md LICENSE palette scripts tests variants .github
scripts.build: npm run build:dark && npm run build:light
scripts.build:dark: web-ext build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --filename firefox-apollo-theme.zip --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md CLAUDE.md LICENSE palette scripts tests variants .github
